title: ConnectionsHostModeParams
description: Params for connections.hostMode: the saved connection whose host's integration method the editor shows (ADR-727g63tr decision 1). The method belongs to the HOST, keyed by its host-key fingerprint, so this names a connection and the backend resolves that connection's destination exactly as an open would — alias and port through ~/.ssh/config, and the route identity a jump-routed destination is kept under — to the fingerprints known_hosts holds for it.

profileId.description: The saved connection whose host is asked about. Required: there is no answer without a destination to look up.
